name: Market Morning
tagline: A pre-open and post-close briefing built around your own watchlist
description: Each trading day it frames the names you follow before the bell and recaps them after the close: notable moves, earnings reports and fresh filings, every point tied to a source you can open yourself. Made for investors who direct their own research and want context before acting, not a feed of tips from a stranger.
